scope: Both exact Release workloads, both backends. New assembly evidence required; unchanged Phase28 provider tests reused only with source-impact proof.
finite: All bodies, rotations, impulses, errors, inertia, elapsed times finite; normalized orientation |q norm-1|<=1e-5. No crash/assertion, invalid handle access, ownership leak or resource overflow.

contact.definition: Minimum full thickness of either colliding box, excluding a larger floor/wall; for reference every body minimum thickness=.5m.
contact.episode: First geometric overlap>.005 at tick t requires <=.005 by t+4 and both following ticks; re-crossing does not reset deadline. Pending episode at end FAIL. All-tick .010 limit always applies.
contact.measurement: Every enabled body-floor/nonadjacent pair each tick, normalized 15-axis OBB SAT min(rA+rB-|delta dot axis|); depth=max(0,min). Use actual body geometry/transforms, double precision, skip only cross axes norm<1e-10. Manifold absence never substitutes zero. Record actual contact IDs and impulse provenance.
contact.coverage: Each workload must have >=1 actual floor contact with nonzero response and measured positive geometric overlap, followed by clearance/recovery. Record all pair depths and maximum. Filtered adjacent penetration is reported separately and cannot stand in for contact coverage.

joints.L_derivation: sum of magnitudes of original COM-local endpoint lever arms, fixed for each packet
joints.aggregate: sum absolute anchor errors <= fraction * sum L; individual bound also required, no cancellation
joints.angular: Reuse Phase28 definitions: hinge axis alignment and CV relation residual <=.005 quiet/.010 transient; limited angle violation <=.005 rad quiet/.010 rad transient. Use actual AngularJoint::Observe plus independent frame calculations; permitted coordinates are not errors.
joints.dynamic_coverage: TILT case: each hinge signed angle and each shoulder U/V coordinate must visit both bound neighborhoods (within .05 rad) after tick0, and exit each to >=.10 rad inside that bound on a later tick. No pre-positioned limit counts. If fixed excitation fails coverage, preserve FAIL and require causal versioned input correction; no tolerance reduction.
joints.mapping: All 6 bone keys/5 joints unique, generation-safe, exact endpoints and Chapter21 rest frames; render-to-body COM/quaternion parity <=1e-5 per component up to quaternion sign.

settling.rationale: 15s initial fall/contact/excitation settling budget (TILT final excitation tick391 leaves >8s); retain 2s wake-response settling interval. These are frozen proposed Phase29 workload windows, not inherited proof or forced-sleep calls.
settling.quiet: sleeping OR speed<=.05m/s AND angular speed<=.02rad/s, all dynamic endpoints for 30 consecutive ticks; fixed settle windows require actual all-asleep states and zero uncommanded wakes
settling.measurements: Every sliding60 window wholly inside a settled window. Euclidean position diameter; shortest quaternion arc diameter; 3-point residual x_t-(x_(t-1)+x_(t+1))/2 and sign-invariant slerp equivalent. Joint high-frequency residual applies throughout loaded motion.

energy.raw: E=sum(.5*m*v^2+.5*omega dot I_world omega+m*10*y). E-E_tick0-sum(actual work)<=allowance at every tick. No potential-height clamping or hidden work.
energy.rest_derivation: .5 * smallest reference mass .5kg * quiet speed .05^2: one quiet-link allowance for entire assembly
energy.loaded_allowance: Before first external action use .000625J. Thereafter max(.000625, .1025 * sum nominal positive isolated kinetic increments of admitted actions so far). .1025=1.05^2-1, same delegated 5% equivalent impulse-speed excess. Compute nominal increment from frozen mass/inertia and packet impulses, not observed favorable data. Actual W still uses measured pre-state.
energy.quiet_gate: Additionally E_t-E_900<=.000625 over 901..960 and E_t-E_1080<=.000625 over1081..1200; no actions inside those windows.
energy.trend: OLS slope of nonoverlapping completed60tick means of E-E0-cumulativeW after tick420 through1200 <=.000625/12 J/s; also report full-run slope and raw peaks. Fixed bins, no data trimming.

cost.method: Every completed Release tick including sleep/contact/action ticks; statistic+measured q, nearest rank p95/p99, all sliding60 means, no warmup deletion, pooling or observer subtraction.
cost.report: mean,median,p95,p99,max,max sliding60 for inclusive Update and available nested joint/contact/graph/filter/arena costs; nested durations not summed as disjoint
cost.goal: GOAL_ONLY on pinned qualified hardware; no invented PASS when target/hardware not established
cost.observer: Same tick U=Update and O=additional observation; state/parity capture common outside both. mean/median(O)+2q<=dt/100; p95/max sliding60(O)+2q<=dt/50. Include allocator management in U.
cost.allocations: Zero incremental joint-induced steady-state heap calls and bytes on both providers. Construction/teardown separate; all sites attributed, no netting frees. Only separately approved bounded Jolt arena reservations allowed.

lifetime: Deterministic partial creation rollback at each of 6 body and 5 joint positions; joints before owned bodies; unrelated static sentinel and old committed scene unchanged; repeated destroy idempotent; deletion of each member retires incident joints and makes stale mapping a typed failure; no ABA identity reuse.
human: Actual ordinary Editor inspection remains mandatory. Numeric PASS cannot override implausible motion, persistent jitter, visible penetration or authoring failures. F_OWNER=PENDING.
no_waivers: No global slop/sleep/solver/material tuning, Native contact repair, rejected Phase21 candidate, or absolute Phase28 .003/.006 reuse on a different .5m feature scale.
